description: 국가철도공단 대구2호선 비상사다리 [railways and stations] (series on Public Data Portal (data.go.kr)) is a series of datasets listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 국가철도공단. 터널 내 대피가 필요한 경우, 승강장에 설치된 비상 사다리를 이용해 침착하게 터널로 이동하세요 역과 역 사이 또는 승강장 화재로 지상으로 대피가 불가능할 때에는 - 승강장에 비치된. Coverage: South Korea. The portal lists 3 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher 국가철도공단. Its tags are 도시광역철도, 사다리, 대구지하철2호선, 노선명, 역명. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-12-02 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
